name: CL1301.7-1139 outskirts (Hubble)
blurb: An outskirts field of the galaxy cluster CL1301.7-1139, seen by Hubble.
label: cl13011-hubble
story: On the outskirts of a distant galaxy cluster, galaxies are still arriving; Hubble surveyed this infall region to see how spiral galaxies are transformed into lenticulars.

claims.text: CL1301.7-1139 is a galaxy cluster in the ESO Distant Cluster Survey (EDisCS)
CL1301-1 is a Hubble pointing of program 13393, which imaged positions in the outskirts of intermediate-redshift galaxy clusters
Program 13393 studies galaxy transformation in the infall regions of clusters
The program seeks what transforms spiral galaxies into lenticular (S0) galaxies
